questions.question: Harihara and Bukka were founders of which one of the following empires?
questions.solution:
• **Harihara and Bukka** are two **brothers** who founded the independent Hindu kingdom of **Vijaynagar**.
 
• The Vijaynagar Kingdom and its Sangama dynasty were founded in 1336 by five sons of Sangama, of whom Harihara and Bukka became the city’s first kings
 
• The Vijaynagar kingdom situated on the southern bank of the river Tungabhadra.
 
• The empire, named after its capital city of Vijaynagar, has impressive ruins surrounding modern Hampi, a World Heritage Site.

questions.question: In which year did Tamerlane invade India?
questions.solution:
• **Tamerlane **or **Timur** marched into **India** with his army and reached Delhi in the year **1398**. 
 
• Attacking the Delhi Sultanate ruled by Sultan Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughluq.
 
• He started his journey from Samarkand. After crossing the Sindh river, he entered Punjab.
 
• He crossed Indus and captured Multan, and just walked over to Delhi without much resistance.
 
• Tamerlane was a Turco-Mongol, who founded the Timurid Empire.

questions.question: Under Article 100(3) of the Constitution, the quorum to constitute a sitting of Lok Sabha is ______ of the total number of Members of the House.
questions.solution:
• Under **Article 100(3)**, the quorum to constitute a meeting of either House of Parliament is **one-tenth** of the total number of members of the House.
 
• If there is no quorum in the House, it shall be the duty of the Chairman, either to adjourn the House or to suspend the meeting until there is a quorum.
 
• The total membership of the Rajya Sabha is 245, therefore, the presence of 25 members is the quorum sufficient to constitute its meeting.

questions.question: What is the common name for the chemical compound Sodium bicarbonate?
questions.solution:

• The structure of the sodium bicarbonate lattice is monoclinic.
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is found in deposits around the world. The deposits of this salt are called nahcolite.
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is an odorless, white crystalline solid or fine powder. It has a slightly alkaline taste.

questions.question: The human skull is a collection of ________ bones.
questions.solution:
• The human skull is generally considered to consist of **twenty**-**two** bones.
 
• In human skull **eight** cranial bones and **fourteen** facial skeleton bones.
 
• The brain is encased in the **cranium** of the skull. The bones that make up the cranium are called the **cranial bones**
 
• The remaining bones in the skull are the** facial bones**.
